candidates.claim: fw-01 accepts HTTP management sessions from 0.0.0.0/0 on the outside interface, so OUTSIDE can open a connection into the MGMT-zone firewall management service.
candidates.remediation: Remove the outside HTTP management entry at fw-01:111 and keep HTTP/ASDM management limited to 10.10.99.0/24 on the mgmt interface.

candidates.claim: rtr-01 interface GigabitEthernet0 (10.10.99.12, MGMT) at rtr-01:46 has no ACL, since rtr-01:38 binds EDGE_IN only to GigabitEthernet0/0/0, and default route rtr-01:54 sends its traffic to the OUTSIDE uplink 198.51.100.1, so MGMT can reach OUTSIDE beyond the approved NTP-only service.
candidates.remediation: Apply an inbound ACL on rtr-01 GigabitEthernet0 that permits only approved MGMT flows (udp/123 to 10.10.20.5) and denies other traffic toward OUTSIDE.

candidates.claim: fw-01 HTTP/ASDM management is permitted from 0.0.0.0/0 on the outside interface, violating the policy that device management is allowed only from MGMT and only on the mgmt interface on fw-01.
candidates.remediation: Remove the outside HTTP management entry at fw-01:111 and restrict HTTP/ASDM management to 10.10.99.0/24 on the mgmt interface.

candidates.claim: Baseline delta: the http 0.0.0.0 management entry at fw-01:111 is an added line relative to the approved baseline and must be reconciled.
candidates.remediation: Revert the added entry to the approved baseline, or document formal approval of the change for reconciliation.
